learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge about characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of gas turbines.
Knowledge about thermodynamic analysis of ideal gas turbine cycles.
Knowledge about main components of gas turbines and their functions.
Knowledge about thermodynamic analysis of gas turbine cycles used in aircrafts.

syllabus_topics: FUNDEMENTAL CONCEPTS: Introduction. Review of thermodynamics
ANALYSIS OF IDEAL CYCLES: Analysis of simple gas turbine cycle (Brayton cycle). Analysis of gas turbine cycles with heat-exchange and with reheat.
ANALYSIS OF IDEAL CYCLES: Analysis of gas turbine cycles with heat-exchange, reheat and intercooled compression.
COMPONENT LOSSES IN GAS TURBINES: Differences between real and ideal cycles. Stagnation properties. Compressor and turbine efficiencies.
COMPONENT LOSSES IN GAS TURBINES: Pressure losses. Heat-exchanger effectiveness. Mechanical losses. Variation of specific heat. Combustion efficiency.
COMPARATIVE PERFORMANCE OF REAL CYCLES: Comparative performance analysis of simple, heat-exchange and heat exchange with reheat or intercooling cycles
GAS TURBINE CYCLES FOR AIRCRAFT PROPULSION: Introduction, criteria of performance. Definition of efficiencies: propulsion efficiency, energy conversion efficiency, total efficiency.
GAS TURBINE CYCLES FOR AIRCRAFT PROPULSION: Thermodynamic analysis of simple turbojet cycle. Optimization of turbojet cycle.
GAS TURBINE CYCLES FOR AIRCRAFT PROPULSION: Thermodynamic analysis of turbofan cycle. Optimization of turbofan cycle. Thermodynamic analysis of turbofan.
MAIN COMPONENTS OF GAS TURBINES: Centrifugal and axial flow compressors: their characteristics, their comparisons and velocity triangles.
MAIN COMPONENTS OF GAS TURBINES: Types and characteristics of combustion systems.
MAIN COMPONENTS OF GAS TURBINES: Radial and axial flow turbines: their characteristics, their comparison.
PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS OF GAS TURBINES: Component characteristics. Power output and specific fuel consumption with output speed, elevation
PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS OF GAS TURBINES: Component characteristics. Variation of power output and specific fuel consumption with output speed, elevation.
bibliography: Mattingly J.D., Elements of Gas Turbine Propulsion, McGraw-Hill, Inc., International Editions, 1996.
Saravanamutto H., Rogers G.F.C., Cohen H., Gas Turbine Theory, Prentice Hall, Fifth Edition.
